result.title: Get the Next Moment Right: Short-Term Event Planning for Physically Plausible Video Generation
result.summary: Video generation models synthesize realistic imagery yet still struggle to produce physically plausible evolution. Existing methods guide generation with a motion trajectory predicted for the entire clip in advance, so prediction errors accumulate and degrade later frames. We propose STEP(Short-Term Event Planning), a training-free closed-loop framework that guides generation one short clip at a time. Each round consists of four steps: grounding measures the scene state from the latest frames, event planning predicts the next physical event and renders it into a control clip, latent-guided generation produces the next short clip under this control, and verification checks whether the event occurs and resamples the clip if it does not. Because each round is grounded in the frames actually generated, control relies only on reliable short-range predictions. STEP improves the physical plausibility of three frozen generators on Physics-IQ Verified and PhyGenBench, and can be applied to new generators without training.

AI.brief_summary: 面向视频生成的物理合理性，提出无需训练的闭环框架 STEP：按短片段逐轮推进，先从已生成帧中定位场景状态，再预测下一物理事件并渲染为控制片段，在控制下做 latent 引导生成，最后验证事件是否发生、不成立则重采样。
AI.relevance_reason: 「基于实际生成帧重新接地状态 + 验证失败即重采样」的短程闭环，可能为 LVR 的潜状态更新、视觉证据筛选与继续/重做决策提供可核查的方法线索；但其对象是视频像素生成，与 VLM 推理中的 latent 推理状态是否同构尚待确认。
